_comment: Reference shape only. Claude Code does not load this file (the loader is scoped to settings.json / settings.local.json). The active shared file is generated by setup.sh at ~/Projects/Wiser/.claude/settings.json with absolute command paths so hooks resolve from any Wiser repo's cwd, not just this one. The generated file carries a _managed_by marker so setup.sh does not clobber a settings.json you edited by hand; replace <HOME> below with your real home path if you merge these entries in manually. See README.md 'How it works' and .claude/hooks/README.md for setup details.
